_note: Sound Menu (manual L1640-L1659): exactly two rows defined — Sound and Flight Sounds. W3-B (plan SE-COMPLETE-1012): those two rows are now WIRED (wired:true) — they route through applySettings and land on se.settings.{sound,flightSounds}; the audio system (systems/audio.js) is the live consumer. A Volume row (0..1, no manual source) is ADDED per the W3-B brief — flagged _source: 'brief:W3-B' (deviation from strict manual-only doctrine, documented). Every option row carries wired:true. The `events` map is NOT a settings section: it is the per-game-event synth-recipe data the audio system reads — each recipe is editor-editable DATA (osc type, freq sweep, noise mix, envelope, duration, gain). NO raw PCM anywhere: the OG EXE has none (data/og-assets.json audioScan) — all SFX are WebAudio synthesis of our own.

sound.label: Sound
sound.description: If ON, Scorch generates sound effects; if OFF, it makes no sound at all.

volume.label: Volume
volume.description: Master output volume for all synthesized sound effects (0 = silent).
volume._source: brief:W3-B (no manual row — added per plan SE-COMPLETE-1012 W3-B)

flightSounds.label: Flight Sounds
flightSounds.description: Sounds weapons make in flight: POS by projectile height, VEL by projectile velocity, OFF for none.

events._note: Per-event synth recipes. Fields: osc {type, from, to} (Hz sweep, optional), noise 0..1 (white-noise buffer mix), gain 0..1 (recipe peak, scaled by the volume setting), duration seconds, attack seconds. Law: play() schedules (osc?2:0)+(noise>0?2:0) nodes; sound off OR volume 0 -> ZERO nodes.

fire.small._role: fire — cannon shot: short noise burst + low thunk

projectile.flight._role: fly — puttering continuous loop while a projectile is live
